text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Biwa Hayahide in the<n>library, looking
perplexed about<n>something. I stroll over to say hello
and ask what's wrong.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've been reading picture<n>books to children
as an<n>extracurricular activity, but... it's just<n>not
clicking with me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well... You know how fairy tales and<n>legends aren't
exactly true to life?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I read such stories, I can't<n>help but get
distracted by all the<n>errors in logic and
inconsistencies in<n>them.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I think I can see where she's coming<n>from, but I
don't fully understand<n>what she means.
choice_data_list:
Can you read one of those stories to me and point
out what you mean?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sure, that seems like the bestapproach. Allow me to readMomotaro for you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Once upon a time, in a land far away...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
An old woman found a giant peach<n>and took it
home.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She and her husband go to cut the<n>peach, when
suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
See, here's the part where my<n>suspension of
disbelief starts to<n>break down.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I already had trouble swallowing the<n>fact that a
giant peach was floating<n>down the river out of
nowhere...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But then we discover that Momotaro<n>was inside of
the peach the whole<n>time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Based on the information available,<n>we have to
assume that he must<n>have been inside it for
anywhere<n>between a few minutes to an hour.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, how did he not die<n>of
asphyxiation?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then there's the part where the old<n>man and
woman cut the peach in half.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How did they avoid cutting Momotaro<n>in half too?
Did they take care to cut<n>around him or something?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But that wouldn't make any sense<n>since they
didn't even know he was<n>in there.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even if I am, what benefit is there to<n>learn about
things that are logically<n>impossible?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'd rather not take part in teaching<n>falsities to
children.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
From the look on her face, I can tell<n>she's truly
dedicated to this. If she's<n>going to take things this
seriously,<n>then...
choice_data_list: Why don't you put your own twist on things?
Why don't you put your own twist on things?
Why don't you make it a study group activity?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
From the look on her face, I can tell<n>she's truly
dedicated to this. If she's<n>going to take things this
seriously,<n>then...
choice_data_list: Why don't you put your own twist on things?
Why don't you put your own twist on things?
Why don't you make it a study group activity?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: My own twist?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Try inserting some logic in the stories.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You mean reconstruct them in a way<n>that makes
sense? That does sound<n>intriguing...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When it's time for Biwa Hayahide to<n>read to the
children again, she put her<n>new tactic to work.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
An old woman found a giant peach<n>and took it
home.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The old man and woman were<n>puzzled by the
strange hole in the<n>peach and realized it must've
been a<n>breathing hole.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Together, the two of them cut into the<n>peach very,
very carefully.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Child
text_block_list.text:
The peach had a breathing hole in it? I<n>don't
remember that part...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But if there wasn't one, Momotaro<n>wouldn't be
able to breathe inside the<n>peach.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It would be very sad if that were the<n>case, don't
you think?

text_block_list.name: Precocious Child
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It would be super, duper sad!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. A kind stranger must have<n>thought the same
and made that hole<n>for him.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Now, back to the story...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Momotaro emerged from the peach<n>hale and whole
thanks to the<n>breathing hole.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And because the old man and woman<n>had cut into
the peach so carefully, he<n>didn't have a single
scratch on him.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Child
text_block_list.text: Yay! He was okay!

text_block_list.name: Precocious Child
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Good for Momotaro!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide's logically rewritten<n>children's
stories initially cause some<n>confusion...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But in the end, it was a highly<n>educational
experience for the<n>children.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: A study group, you say?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The children might find such a thing<n>dull, but holding
a group discussion<n>might be a good way to discuss
the<n>flaws in such stories.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I like that idea! I'll start preparing<n>for our
discussion right away!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When it's time for Biwa Hayahide to<n>read to the
children again, she<n>carefully presents her ideas to
her<n>audience.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The glass slippers Cinderella wore<n>may look
beautiful, but they're<n>actually incredibly dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Because glass is hard, the likelihood<n>of injuring
your feet while wearing<n>them is high.

And if they were to break, they would<n>leave glass
shards everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Child
text_block_list.text: Wow! That would be really bad!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. That's why you should wear<n>shoes made
from safe materials and<n>not glass slippers, even if
they're<n>from a fairy godmother.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When the Big Bad Wolf asked Little<n>Red Riding
Hood where she was<n>going, she told him, thus
revealing the<n>location of her grandmother's house.

However, if she had kept her guard<n>up and refused
to answer, her<n>grandmother would've escaped the
tragic fate of being eaten.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The moral of the story is that you<n>should run away
from a stranger if<n>they try to talk to you.
Understood?

text_block_list.name: Precocious Child
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Although picture books can be quite<n>charming, they
occasionally contain<n>problematic elements.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You have to learn how to identify<n>these problems
and avoid them in<n>order to live a good life.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now, were you all able to learn<n>something new from
today's story<n>time?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We did!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide's educational story<n>time ends up
being a big hit.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Not only did the children love her, but<n>she seems to
have greatly enjoyed<n>herself too.
